catatan.detail: permukaan AI ada dan tampak (ai-panel=true, tampak=true, ai-chat=true, ai-host=true, kolom right)
garis dasar bersih sebelum uji: halaman Setelan lama TIDAK terbuka (settings-page=false, activity=explorer [dasar explorer], settingsOpen=false)
tidak ada kontrol bernama lama (settings-page/open-settings) di permukaan AI (dari 35 testid; yang berbau "settings/setelan": [-])
KONTROL - halaman Setelan lama memang terdeteksi saat sengaja dibuka lewat bukaSet() (settings-page=true, topbar=true, activity=settings, settingsOpen=true)

banner kunci di panel chat (ai-nokey-open): TIDAK membuka halaman Setelan lama; mendarat di Chat Settings terbuka (seksinya diperiksa di B) — setelanLama=tidak activity=explorer settingsOpen=false | cset=terbuka seksi=cset-nav-models baris=[cset-row-askmodel,cset-row-provider2,cset-row-baseurl,cset-row-keys,cset-row-hydra,cset-row-hydrantingkat,cset-row-hydrabiaya,cset-row-hydraterakhir]

menu "…" panel chat (ai-open-chat-settings): TIDAK membuka halaman Setelan lama; mendarat di Chat Settings terbuka (seksi bawaan, tanpa target) — setelanLama=tidak activity=explorer settingsOpen=false | cset=terbuka seksi=cset-nav-mode baris=[cset-row-dispatch,cset-row-runmode,cset-row-reasoning]

pemilih model panel chat (ai-model-edit): TIDAK membuka halaman Setelan lama; mendarat di Chat Settings pada seksi Models — setelanLama=tidak activity=explorer settingsOpen=false | cset=terbuka seksi=cset-nav-models baris=[cset-row-askmodel,cset-row-provider2,cset-row-baseurl,cset-row-keys,cset-row-hydra,cset-row-hydrantingkat,cset-row-hydrabiaya,cset-row-hydraterakhir]

pemilih model header subagent (sub-model-edit): TIDAK membuka halaman Setelan lama; mendarat di Chat Settings pada seksi Models — setelanLama=tidak activity=explorer settingsOpen=false | cset=terbuka seksi=cset-nav-models baris=[cset-row-askmodel,cset-row-provider2,cset-row-baseurl,cset-row-keys,cset-row-hydra,cset-row-hydrantingkat,cset-row-hydrabiaya,cset-row-hydraterakhir]

baris izin-tulis di tampilan subagent (sav-tulis-setelan): TIDAK membuka halaman Setelan lama; mendarat di Chat Settings pada seksi Sub-agents — setelanLama=tidak activity=explorer settingsOpen=false | cset=terbuka seksi=cset-nav-subagent baris=[cset-row-subwrite,cset-row-subpanel,cset-row-parallel,cset-row-steps,cset-row-idle,cset-row-submodel2,cset-row-subworker]

baris personas di menu mode (ai-mode-manage): TIDAK membuka halaman Setelan lama; mendarat di Agent Customizations (bukan halaman Setelan) — setelanLama=tidak activity=explorer settingsOpen=false | cset=tidak seksi=- baris=[] | agent-custom=terbuka
banner kunci mendarat di seksi Models (akar halaman tampak=true, nav aktif=cset-nav-models, baris model=[cset-row-keys,cset-row-askmodel] dari [cset-row-keys,cset-row-askmodel], judul=[Models])

baris subagent mendarat di seksi Sub-agents (akar halaman tampak=true, nav aktif=cset-nav-subagent, baris=[cset-row-subwrite,cset-row-subpanel,cset-row-parallel,cset-row-steps,cset-row-idle,cset-row-submodel2,cset-row-subworker], judul=[Sub-agents])

tab panel bawah tidak memuat tab AI (terrender=[problems,output,debug,terminal,ports,subagents], menu=[problems,output,debug,terminal,ports,subagents], semua tab=[problems,output,debug,terminal,ports,subagents], aktif=subagents, entri berbau AI=[-])
